countingRule: A card is counted as a complete gain only when every currently unsupported ability is covered by the same precise correction. Touched abilities, shared vocabulary, or an executable primitive without a complete parent do not count as completed cards.

rankedAlternatives.concept: step-began triggered envelope delegating to EffectSequence

cards.name: Phyrexian Arena
cards.oracle: At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw a card and lose 1 life.

rankedAlternatives.missing: LocalTriggerEventNode has no generic step-began atom yet; the parent and lowerer must preserve the controller-relative upkeep.

rankedAlternatives.concept: controlled permanent-entry event with typed predicate feeding EffectSequence

cards.name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
cards.oracle: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life and draw a card.

rankedAlternatives.missing: The existing controlled-entry recognizer is private to a specialized reflexive-counter grammar; it must become a shared event atom and accept an ability-word prefix without absorbing the body.

cards.name: Feed the Swarm
cards.oracle: Destroy target creature or enchantment an opponent controls. You lose life equal to that permanent's mana value.

rankedAlternatives.missing: The numeric child accepts only `that card's`; the parent lowerer also currently rejects target-bound numeric expressions. Runtime proof must preserve mana value after the target leaves, including token and replacement cases.

rankedAlternatives.concept: arbitrary-permanent sacrifice activation cost followed by add-mana

cards.name: Phyrexian Altar
cards.oracle: Sacrifice a creature: Add one mana of any color.

rankedAlternatives.missing: ActivationCostSequence currently models sacrifice-self, not a chosen controlled permanent. The cost decision, legality, payment ordering, and produced-mana choice require a shared cost atom and runtime proof.

rankedAlternatives.concept: entered-tapped event object binding followed by untap

cards.name: Amulet of Vigor
cards.oracle: Whenever a permanent you control enters tapped, untap it.

rankedAlternatives.missing: The runtime permanentEntered matcher does not retain an entered-tapped qualifier. This cannot be counted as the same correction as Tatyova until event-state capture and anaphoric triggering-permanent lowering are proved.

twoOrMoreCardCandidates.reason: The current engine has not certified one simultaneous destruction batch. Sequential application can change static/replacement effects before later permanents are destroyed.

Tatyova needs a controlled Land predicate and ordinary life/draw sequence; Amulet needs an entered-tapped state snapshot plus triggering-object untap. They share an event family but not the missing semantic atom.

newRound5Cards.note: The in-flight generic death event may touch the second ability but cannot complete the card by itself.

decision: No safe exact correction completes two or more round5 cards after excluding the in-flight death work. Implement the static additionalLandPlay child next; keep mass destruction deferred and do not merge Tatyova and Amulet into an inflated event claim.
